cr_data.provenance: (The Intimate Gallery, New York, NY); Heda Kuhn, New York, NY, 1928; Private collection, Marco Island, Florida, gift, 1960 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Derives from Alfred Stieglitz photograph of O'Keeffe, albeit reversed, see *Georgia O'Keeffe: A Portrait by Alfred Stieglitz* (1978), page 28. Verso of cat. no. 421 (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: This artwork is on the back of *Alligator Pears*, 1923 (cat. no. 421).
